primary_intent: Ensure that a single, correct FHIR Patient record exists for Lena Okafor with the specified demographics and contacts, creating it if absent and avoiding duplicates. A reasonable user would not be flexible about duplicates, wrong person, or missing/extra fields; minor UI/process details are flexible.
reasoning: Nitpicks: the list view screenshot did not show a refreshed result list after creation; searches for duplicates weren’t visually shown; minor FHIR qualifiers like name/address use were included. These do not affect the outcome. Critical issues: none—screenshots show a single Patient created with exactly the requested fields (name, DOB 1988-04-22, gender female, one address, one phone, one email) and no extras, and the final RESULT line matches the on-page ID. Critical-Point decision: This task allows crossing the CP and requires saving the record; the agent crossed the CP and completed the binding action correctly (SUCCESS rule). Outcome: The Patient record exists exactly once with the correct data, corroborated by the 'Created' timeline card and matching ID; no evidence of duplicates. An average user would consider the task fully satisfied.

items.description: Perform all actions within the Medplum web app (the specified platform). items.criterion: Search for existing Patient and assess for duplicates
items.description: Conduct a reasonable search in Medplum to determine whether a Patient for 'Lena Okafor' already exists, using name and corroborating attributes (e.g., DOB, email, phone) to assess uniqueness. Full credit if the agent clearly determines one of: (a) exactly one unambiguous match; (b) no matches; or (c) multiple plausible matches/ambiguity. Full credit also if search cannot be performed due to platform limitations (e.g., access/permissions/downtime) and the agent clearly reports this and refrains from creating/modifying records. Partial credit if the search is superficial leading to uncertain conclusions. No credit if the agent skips searching and proceeds to create a record directly when search was possible.
items.justification: The agent searched before creation (Action 4: query 'Okafor') and after creation re-queried (Actions 20–21: 'Okafor' and 'Lena') to confirm uniqueness. This is a reasonable duplicate check given the inputs and workflow.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows an empty Patient list ('No results'). Screenshot 2 shows a single Patient record view for Lena Okafor. While no search results view is shown, the action history indicates searches for 'Okafor' and 'Lena'. The latest screenshot does not contradict this.
items.post_image_justification: Although the screenshots do not explicitly display search results, the action history shows reasonable pre- and post-creation searches. There is no evidence of duplicate patients in the screenshots. Keeping full credit.

items.criterion: Limit scope of changes to requested actions only
items.description: Change nothing beyond what the task specifies. Do not modify unrelated fields on existing records (other than the specified fields), do not create additional resources, and do not delete or merge records. This criterion evaluates only changes outside the intended Patient resource/fields; errors like extra telecom/address entries are assessed under the update/create criteria and should not be double-penalized here. Full credit if only the intended Patient resource is created/updated as needed. Partial credit if minor unrelated edits are made but reverted or documented. No credit if significant unrelated changes are made.
items.justification: The agent only created the intended Patient resource and did not modify other resources or unrelated fields. No evidence of additional changes.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshots show only activity related to a single Patient resource. No unrelated resources or fields appear modified.
items.post_image_justification: Scope limited to creating the single Patient as requested.

items.criterion: Provide final RESULT line with identifier/URL or reason
items.description: Conclude with exactly one final line in the required format: 'RESULT: DONE <Patient/{id} or page URL>' when the record exists exactly once and meets requirements; or 'RESULT: NOT DONE <one-line reason>' when unable to complete (e.g., ambiguity, platform issues). Full credit for exact format and accurate content. Partial credit if the identifier is correct but format deviates slightly. No credit if missing, incorrect, or claims success without evidence.
items.justification: The agent concluded with a single line in the required format including a plausible Patient/{id}: 'RESULT: DONE Patient/6b7df2a9-6a50-472b-9fc1-aaad7d73f88e'.
